description: Full OSV record for one vulnerability id (GHSA-..., CVE-..., PYSEC-..., GO-..., RUSTSEC-..., OSV-...): details, aliases, related ids, every affected package with ranges and versions, references, credits, database_specific fields, plus a normalized severity label and computed CVSS v3 score. Vulnerability data from OSV.dev (CC-BY 4.0); package metadata from deps.dev. Unknown ids and upstream errors are not charged. Costs $0.001 USDC per call via x402.
name: vuln_details
